_comment: Per-asset cross-venue lead/lag calibration for asset-specific Gate H scoring. Generated from Pass-12 lag-scan results (commit 1c328cf). Pass-12 used 30d corpora for both assets. Re-run lag scan periodically (Pass-N+5 or after major venue/microstructure changes) and update this file.

BTC.interpretation: CB-BTC leads KR-BTC by 15 minutes for regime classification. Plateau above 60% strict spans lag +8 to +21 (14 min wide), giving the system tolerance to ~±6 min lag drift around the +15 peak. Combined with sub-minute Bybit-perp lead over CB-BTC spot, Bybit-perp leads KR-BTC spot by ~15+ min total.

ETH.interpretation: Empirical record from Pass-11 lag scan: across ±10 min in 1-min steps, ETH cross-venue agreement varied between 33.9-35.2% (strict) and 56.2-57.9% (relaxed). Neither metric clears the 60% threshold at any scanned lag; ETH FAILS Gate H. The structural_divergence flag is a tag for downstream tooling that 'we have already scanned this asset across the standard range and no lag rescues the gate' — it is informational metadata, not a pass override. Gate H verdict reflects the actual measurement.
